clothing.rule: No garment may hide body regions unless the occlusion is intentional for that facing and supported by the approved dressed benchmark. Open garment regions remain transparent.

hair.blocker: true hairless body master still required

rules.source_isolation: Reject neighboring-item pixels, labels, panel borders, presentation shadows, unrelated direction art, opaque sheet background, and opaque interior presentation fill.
rules.paper_doll_anchor: All character layers share the same 480x640 anatomical body lattice; do not independently center or bottom-justify them.
rules.runtime_gate: No 48x64 derivation until a source-quality clean-chest body and hairless master exist, direction-aware clothing sublayers match the dressed benchmark, equipment is registered, and the four missing NW equipment views are authored.
